brief.meaningEn: Short or small enough to take in as one manageable unit, especially when information is divided into parts. It does not guarantee that the content itself is simple.
brief.meaningZh: 篇幅短或份量小，讓人可以一次處理一個單元，尤其用於分拆後的資訊；不保證內容本身容易理解。
brief.grammar: Bite-sized or bite-size as an adjective, usually before a noun such as lesson, guide or chunk. The source also uses the natural predicative form “the lessons are bite-sized”. The food sense is separate.
brief.register: Informal-to-neutral educational and explanatory language. A trainer may use it with new volunteers; an editor may use it with readers deciding how to follow a complex guide.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是資訊或任務被分成較短、較易逐一處理的單元；一篇再淺易但兩小時不間斷的長講解，不因為內容簡單便叫 bite-sized。
brief.misconceptionZh: 原文同時用了 easy to digest；那是理解難度的另一個說法，不是 bite-sized 的固定部分。短小的單元仍可能包含困難概念。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出原本內容如何被分成短單元、每單元的範圍，以及內容是否仍須解釋或練習。

sources.sentence: The lessons are bite-sized and easy to digest.

listening.promptZh: 市立圖書館如何改編一個長篇檔案介紹？

options.en: It divided the introduction into six short guides, each on one collection.
options.zh: 它把介紹分成六段短導覽，每段講一個藏品系列。

options.en: It made six guides but repeated the entire introduction in every one.
options.zh: 它製作六段導覽，但每段都重複整篇介紹。

options.en: It made one four-minute guide covering all six collections.
options.zh: 它製作一段四分鐘的導覽，一次講完六個藏品系列。

options.en: It shortened only the printed labels and kept a single long audio talk.
options.zh: 它只縮短印刷標籤，語音講解仍是一整段長篇。

listening.explanationZh: 錄音明說由一篇長介紹改為六段各四分鐘、每段講一個系列的導覽；短小不表示陌生詞語已全部變容易。
listening.en: The city library replaced one long archive introduction with six bite-sized audio guides. Each guide lasts four minutes and covers one collection, though visitors may still need help with unfamiliar terms.
listening.zh: 市立圖書館把一篇長篇檔案介紹改成六段短小的語音導覽。每段長四分鐘，只介紹一個藏品系列；訪客遇到陌生詞語時仍可能需要協助。

reply.promptEn: Our volunteer induction covers twelve procedures in one uninterrupted session. New helpers say they lose track after the first few. How could we redesign it?
reply.promptZh: 我們的義工入職簡介會把十二項程序放在一堂不間斷的課裏。新義工說，頭幾項之後便跟不上。我們可以怎樣重新設計？

options.en: We could group the procedures into short sections and pause for a check after each group.
options.zh: 我們可以把程序分成短章節，每組後停下來核對理解。

options.en: We could use a short card for each procedure and pause after every card during the session.
options.zh: 我們可以每項程序用一張短卡，並在課堂上講完每張卡後停一停。

options.en: We could make bite-sized modules, each covering one or two procedures, while keeping a full reference sheet.
options.zh: 我們可以把課程分成短小單元，每個講一兩項程序，並保留完整參考表。

options.en: We could teach the urgent procedures first and schedule separate brief sessions for the rest.
options.zh: 我們可以先教緊急程序，其餘安排另外幾節短課。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都把不間斷的十二項程序改為較短、可逐步處理的安排；金句用 bite-sized 指單元篇幅，不聲稱程序本身簡單。

scene.promptZh: 博物館把一張極長的展品背景說明改成八張短卡，每張只講一個年代，旁邊仍附完整資料。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The museum made the timeline bite-sized without removing the full reference.
options.zh: 博物館把時間線分成短小單元，同時保留完整參考資料。

options.en: Each short card still repeats the entire timeline, so visitors face the same amount at once.
options.zh: 每張短卡仍重複整條時間線，訪客一次要處理的資料量並沒有減少。

options.en: The museum offers a shorter overview but no longer provides the full background.
options.zh: 博物館提供較短的概覽，但不再附上完整背景資料。

scene.explanationZh: 八張各講一個年代的短卡符合短小分節，完整參考仍在；另兩句分別改寫了每卡內容及是否保留完整資料。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合用 bite-sized 描述資訊的呈現方式？

options.en: A language app offers five-minute practice cards, each about one verb form.
options.zh: 語言應用程式提供每張五分鐘、各講一種動詞形式的練習卡。

options.en: A lecturer speaks for two hours without a break, though the vocabulary is familiar.
options.zh: 講者用熟悉的詞語連續講兩小時，中間沒有分節或休息。

options.en: A safety guide splits a complex process into separate one-step panels.
options.zh: 安全指引把複雜流程分成各講一步的獨立圖文。

contrast.explanationZh: 用詞熟悉不等於篇幅短或可分段處理；另外兩項都把內容分成小單元。

dialogue.promptZh: 甲說：「市政部門的防洪義工手冊有五十頁，新義工說一次看不完，但內容不能隨便刪。」乙怎樣回應最合宜？

options.en: We could make bite-sized practice sheets for each task and keep the full manual for reference.
options.zh: 我們可以為每項工作製作短小練習單，並保留完整手冊作參考。

options.en: We could shorten the manual by removing the more technical but required procedures.
options.zh: 我們可以刪掉較艱深但仍必需的程序，以縮短手冊。

options.en: We could add headings, then still ask everyone to read all fifty pages in one sitting.
options.zh: 我們可以加上標題，但仍要求大家一次讀完五十頁。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句保留不可刪的完整內容，同時按工作拆成短小練習單；另兩項分別刪去必需程序或仍要求一次讀完。

speaking.en: The archive team turned its long scanning guide into bite-sized cards, one for naming files and another for checking image quality.
speaking.zh: 檔案團隊把冗長的掃描指引分成短小的卡片，一張講檔案命名，另一張講影像質素檢查。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出檔案團隊如何把長指引分成可逐一處理的卡片。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區劇團要教新成員使用燈光控制台，原有兩小時講解一次過介紹所有功能。用一至兩句英文建議短小練習單元，並說明仍需要練習或查閱完整說明。
writing.selfCheckZh: 須指出原來是兩小時不間斷講解，建議按一兩項燈光功能分成短單元，並保留練習或完整說明；不可聲稱控制台因此變得毫無難度。

examples.en: Instead of a two-hour talk on every lighting control, the theatre could offer bite-sized lessons on one setting at a time and let members practise with the full manual nearby.
examples.zh: 劇團可不用兩小時一次講完所有燈光控制，而是每節短課只教一項設定，讓成員在完整手冊旁實際練習。

examples.en: The team could replace the uninterrupted two-hour introduction with bite-sized practice sessions covering two controls each; new members could consult the complete guide between sessions.
examples.zh: 團隊可把不間斷的兩小時介紹改成短小練習課，每節講兩項控制功能；新成員可在課與課之間查閱完整指引。

takeaways.en: Bite-sized lessons reduce the amount presented at once; they do not make every idea easy.
takeaways.zh: 短小課節減少一次呈現的份量，並不令每個概念都變容易。

takeaways.en: The editor made the guide bite-sized by separating the checks into short cards.
takeaways.zh: 編輯把檢查項目分成短卡，令指引變得短小、可逐項處理。
